The universal high-end measuring machine
for manufacturers of threading tools

Inquire now

blocks.body:
The universal high-end measuring machine »threadCheck cc« from ZOLLER sets new standards for the fully automatic complete measurement of all types of cutting tools and is specialized for thread and gear cutting tools.

Intelligent multi-sensor technology and functional full enclosure, combined with the universal tool holder system including Tailstock, make the ZOLLER »threadCheck cc« unique worldwide.

Request now 1:1 expert meeting

Calibrating measuring devices on site with certified test specimens and reference standards is an important part of quality assurance at E. ZOLLER GmbH & Co. KG - this is how we guarantee reliable measurement results and the high precision of your products in accordance with applicable standards.

spots.label: Switch cabinet
spots.text:
Switch cabinet

Switch cabinet

Switch cabinet - with active ventilation. The electronic components are carefully and safely installed for trouble-free operation. In addition, optimum ease of maintenance and service is guaranteed.

spots.label: Incident light camera
spots.text:
Incident light camera

Incident light camera with multi-LED segment lighting and CNC swivel device

Incident light camera with multi-LED segment illumination and CNC swivel device - for the inspection and automatic measurement of tool geometries on the circumference, in the chip space and on the face. Simply enter the target parameters in the measuring program dialog and each measured variable is automatically measured and logged: rake angle, clearance angle, groove contour, chamfer width and many other geometries. The high-performance LEDs, segmented into eight areas, are automatically controlled by the measuring system and ensure optimum illumination of the surface thanks to automatic intensity control - for high precision and repeat accuracy.

spots.label: »orthoScan«
spots.text:
»orthoScan«

»OrthoScan« swivel multisensor optics carrier

»OrthoScan« swiveling multisensor optics carrier - always finds the perfect viewing angle on the tool. This means that the cutting edge geometries of tools with a pitch, such as taps or hobs, can be measured in transmitted light without distortion.

spots.label: Sliding door
spots.text:
Sliding door

Space-saving and ergonomic sliding door

Space-saving and ergonomic sliding door - reliably keeps out external influences such as dirt or extraneous light during measurement. The generous opening, even in the upper area, makes it possible to load and unload heavy tools using lifting gear or a crane.

spots.label: High-end design
spots.text:
High-end design

High-end design

High-end design - with the device base made of hard stone as a high-precision platform for the measuring device tower, spindle and tailstock.

spots.label: Security package
spots.text:
Security package

Safety package

Safety package - in which important operating elements are located on the front of the measuring machine. This means you always have unrestricted access to the emergency stop switch, the reset button, the membrane keypad and the button for starting measuring processes.

spots.label: Vibration decoupling
spots.text:
Vibration decoupling

Vibration decoupling

Vibration decoupling - the integrated, active vibration damping with automatic level control absorbs external vibration influences at the installation site.

spots.label: Transmitted light camera
spots.text:
Transmitted light camera

Transmitted light camera with multi-LED illumination

Transmitted light camera with multi-LED illumination - enables μm-precise measurement of cutting edge contours and step geometry in the silhouette with up to 5 Mpx using high-quality, low-distortion optics and telecentric transmitted light. The camera has a high frame rate for fast focus and contour recording from the tool rotation. The multi-LED ring light ensures high-intensity and high-contrast illumination of the cutting edge inspection in incident light.

spots.label: Pneumatic tailstock
spots.text:
Pneumatic tailstock

Pneumatic tailstock

Pneumatic tailstock - with high-precision moving center allows the holding of long and thin tools as a counter center as well as clamping between centers. The smooth-running quick adjustment ensures sensitive entry into the tool center and the automatic pressure build-up ensures that the tools are held securely without distortion. In addition, the integrated CNC drive enables automation for loading and clamping between centers.

spots.label: »cockpit« control unit
spots.text:
»cockpit« control unit

»cockpit« control unit

»cockpit« control unit - offers the operator ergonomics and comfort thanks to individual adjustment options. The »cockpit« can be adjusted in height and position and the 24″ TFT color monitor can also be tilted.

spots.label: Software »pilot 4.0«
spots.text:
Software »pilot 4.0«

»pilot 4.0« software

»pilot 4.0« software - is self-explanatory, clear and enables the operator to take reliable measurements. It offers a uniform user interface on all ZOLLER systems - right up to ZOLLER TMS Tool Management Solutions. The individual structure of the software allows customer-specific adaptations to be implemented quickly.

Storage options

Storage options - for attachment holders and intermediate sleeves - can be found in the integrated shelves: in the interior for intermediate sleeves and on the side for attachment holders. This means you always have your accessories to hand.

blocks.body:
With ZOLLER »threadCheck ❘ cc« you can measure without contact in transmitted light and incident light: Equipped with CNC-controlled swiveling optics carrier, transmitted light and incident light image processing, you can measure almost anything on all types of cutting tools as well as on threading and gear cutting tools - precisely and fully automatically.

ZOLLER Multisensor Technology High-Precision Spindle »ace«

blocks.title: Multi-sensor technology
blocks.text: The centered multi-LED ring lights ensure ideal illumination on every tool for inspections on the face, on the circumference and in the chip space. The optional electronic measuring probe also offers additional measuring options on threading and gear cutting tools.

blocks.body:
The demands in quality management are constantly increasing. That is why you must be able to rely on the constant measuring deviations of your machines. In ZOLLER measuring machines, high-precision calibration standards made of Borofloatglas® are used to determine the length measurement deviations in accordance with the DIN EN ISO 10360 standard. In accordance with this standard, at least three measuring sequences (25,326 relationships) are carried out. With this procedure, the accuracy of the ZOLLER measuring machines is documented in two dimensions and can be traced at any time.

One-dimensional Two-dimensional

blocks.text: Based on DIN EN ISO 10360,Exy = 2.5 μm + (L/250 mm) μm
